status: Recurring emergence Hit wired; compilation and runtime/player validation deferred

integration.clock: Entry activates R3 at0 without a collision. Each observed update snapshots poll1 in authored R20/R3 order, subtracts stored float priorDelta and ends only when remaining<0, then adds .05f and activates the next poll. Age alone does not decide the last hit.
integration.geometry: Both tracks use actual root. Authored Neck_1 belongs to the Hydra skeleton; lookup in mother_core_skeleton fails and P1 leaves the root matrix. No invented neck replacement. Raw radii20/3 convert once using preserved model scale.
integration.sweep: Native discrete sphere strategy and max(1,ceil(distance/radius),ceil(relativeAngle/1rad)) count retained. Previous basis identity and current root rotation determine angle. The original candidate-derived fraction bracket/endpoints are not closed: fixed i/N, i=1..N is an explicit MC sampling adapter, not a claimed exact native solver.
integration.receipts: R3 may consume a victim before R20 begins. UUID receipt is written before dispatch, including a receiver that rejects hurt. Tracks share receipts, expire only after >5 observed seconds, and clear after the final still-current frame. No strongest-window merge or accepted-only debit.
integration.body: Animated victims use posed cuboids; other living targets use their actual hitboxes; mechanical hulls use articulated boxes; aircraft retain their current yaw-dependent envelope. The earliest MC sample is placed first; remaining spatial-query order is not globally sorted.
integration.world: Only loaded XZ chunks and border are allowed. Underground roots may lie below minBuildHeight. There is no extra eye-to-target terrain ray; native overlap from a buried root would otherwise be suppressed. No block destruction or fabricated Crater damage.
integration.lifecycle: Cancellation, collapse, natural completion, owner disposal and same-object load invalidate in-flight Frames. Checks before/after damage callbacks stop stale work. No skipped-tick catch-up or >8block teleport corridor.
integration.persistence: CycleVersion3 stores Clock and shared receipts only during EMERGING. First update after load starts at loaded root; old snapshots without Hit state resume their pose without retroactive collisions. A complete future emergence initializes a new session.

explicitMinecraftAdapters.categories: LivingEntity and physical hulls represent eligible Health/HitReaction receivers. No claim of complete P1 Prop/Ped/Vehicle membership or receiver semantics; ordinary blocks are not props.
explicitMinecraftAdapters.damage: Living source800/100 use existing Greene .06 balance (48/6 baseline before recipient health units). Mechanical receivers keep source800/100 and existing hull armor; aircraft use raw values. This is balance policy, not an original unit conversion.
explicitMinecraftAdapters.friendly: Dispatch to natural owner allies uses source .01/.2 factors; existing recipient hooks may still reject friendly damage after consuming the receipt. Explicit scoreboard allies and creative/spectator players remain protected; crew protections on mechanical hulls are retained. Disguise does not suppress area contact.
explicitMinecraftAdapters.impulse: Original impulse vectors, mass/force transfer, transformation multiplier and specialized receiver reactions are NOT reproduced. Existing Minecraft damage/physical feedback remains; no native-force fidelity is claimed.

remaining: Opening mission emergence, Crater presentation/lifetime, full native impulse/receiver/filter/sampling behavior and actual player acceptance remain incomplete.
